'''Jomandi Grilao''' was a [[human]] [[Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TA" /> in [[132 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref>

Senator Grilao was the representative of the [[Droma sector]]. Grilao advocated for the suppression of the judiciary. Her robes bore the pattern of the [[Lonnawi Assembly]].<ref name="VG" />

In 132 BBY, Grilao was part of a tribunal convened at the request of [[Worus Rayencourt]] to determine whether the Senate should impose stricter controls on the [[Jedi Order]]. Rayencourt convinced Supreme Chancellor [[Veeth Drellik]] to convene a tribunal, though [[Vernestra Rwoh]] convinced the tribunal that Master [[Sol]] was responsible for the murders and that he alone was responsible. With this, Vernestra concealed much from the Senate and pinned the blame on Sol.<ref name="TA" />
